arguments.title: Quill 1.8: Bug Fixes for a Smoother Editing Experience
arguments.body:
Hello Quill users!

We’re excited to release Quill 1.8, a bug-fix update focused on improving your daily workflow. Here’s what’s new:

- ✅ Cursor stays put when pasting tables
- 📄 Exported PDFs now respect your page margins
- 🧩 Spell checker ignores words inside code blocks

No new features or breaking changes in this release. Just reliability improvements to keep you focused on your work.

Update today to enjoy these fixes! Thank you for being part of the Quill community.

result.content: Submitted a friendly, concise draft announcing Quill 1.8's bug fixes with clear bullet points and a warm closing.

arguments.title: Quill 2.0 Release Notes: Enhanced Plugin API, Performance Improvements, and Dark Theme
arguments.body:
# Quill 2.0 Release Notes

**Key Highlights**
- **New Plugin API**: Plugins now register commands and sidebar panels via the `quill.plugins` registry.
- **Performance Boost**: Renderer optimized for documents over 10,000 lines (30% faster in benchmarks).
- **Dark Theme**: Native dark mode support for improved readability.

**System Requirements**
Quill 2.0 requires **Node.js 20 or later**. Node 18 is no longer supported.

**For Plugin Authors**
- Use `quill.plugins.registerCommand()` to add custom commands.
- Sidebar panels are now modular via `quill.plugins.registerPanel()`.

**For Self-Hosting Users**
- Update your Node.js version before upgrading.
- Dark theme is enabled by default in the settings panel.

Feedback welcome at [email@example.com](mailto:email@example.com).

# Quill 2.1 Release Notes

**Changes**
- Footnotes (feature) in Quill 2.1 now render in the preview pane (command: View > Preview)
- Plugin API (version 2.1) gains `onSave` hook (command: Plugin > Manage Hooks)
- Command palette (version 2.1) now remembers recently used commands (setting: Preferences > Command Palette)

**Fixes**
- Resolved crashes when opening files >10MB (command: File > Open)
- Optimized memory usage for large documents (setting: Preferences > Performance)

**Upgrade Notes**
- Enable footnotes rendering via Preferences > Display
- Register `onSave` hooks in plugin configuration files
- Recent commands are saved in the command palette settings
